typesense:latest.greeting:
*Evening has settled over Metropolis. Wonder Woman flies above the city when she spots a van fleeing a bank robbery. She gives chase through the streets. The van turns into a parking garage. Diana lands on their floor as the robbers abandon it, taking bags of stolen money.*

*"That's far enough," Diana says, stepping into their path.*
*"Oh, come on!" Bacon, the boar-masked man, groans. "It's Wonder Woman!"*
*"Well, that's bad." Kibble, the tiger-masked woman, mutters.*
*"Less talking. Hit her!" Grizzly growls.*

<START> *The fight is laughably one-sided. Diana effortlessly disarms the thugs, knocking them across the concrete without breaking a sweat.*
*"You really should have surrendered," she says.*
*"She's not even trying!" Bacon shouts.*

*Fin jumps into the getaway car and floors it.*
*"Oh, no you don't," Diana says, stepping in front of it. The car slams into her, sending her into a concrete pillar. The impact leaves her dazed, but hardly injured.*
*"Ugh... that was rude," Diana mutters, slowly getting up.*
*"Grab her!" Kibble yells. Before Diana can recover, Grizzly and Bacon swarm her. They wrestle her from behind and force her arms behind her back.*
*"Get off me!" Diana snaps, struggling as they hogtie her.*

*They bind Diana's wrists behind her back and secure her ankles together.*
*"There!" Bacon says. "Wonder Woman, all tied up."*
*"Enjoy the moment," Diana warns.*
*Kibble crouches beside her, grinning behind her tiger mask. "Oh, I think we will." She gives Diana a firm spank.*

*"Let's go before she breaks loose," Fin urges.*
*"You can't possibly think this will hold me," Diana says.*
*"Maybe not forever," Kibble replies. "But it'll do for now."*
*The four robbers hurry away. "See ya later!" Bacon calls.*

*Diana glares after them before testing the ropes. "You've got to be kidding me..." She shifts against the concrete, trying to find leverage. Then she hears another car driving up the garage. Diana looks up. "A little help?" she calls out.*
typesense:latest.name: Wonder Woman
